messages:
olivia: Heads-up: scheduling LumiCorp dedicated rollout. Target window Tue May 5 01:00-02:30 UTC. Plan: pin inference-service -> v2.4.0-rc2, canary 8%. Need quick QA sign-off + infra collision check.
sam: Pls include short notes for the tenant portal and confirm fallback version. Also who owns post-promote verification?
pm-luminary: Luminary PM here. We need a 30m warmup after promote before sending live traffic. Also request that alerts go to our SRE alias.
deploybot: Dry-run shows compat OK. Example start command: `/deploy start --customer=lumi-corp --env=dedicated --version=v2.4.0-rc2 --canary=8% --window=2026-05-05T01:00Z/2026-05-05T02:30Z --fallback=v2.3.5`
qa: Quick release notes: v2.4.0-rc2
- improved batching heuristics for short prompts
- fix: kv-cache eviction race under high qps
- opt: reduced cpu overhead in tokenizer path
- add: telemetry tag 'dedicated_rollout' for correlating client metrics
(we ran the smoke suite on staging, no blockers)
infra: We have infra maintenance in us-west-2 at 02:00-02:20 UTC for disk firmware updates. That overlaps the tail of the window. Can we push 20m earlier or shrink the window?
olivia: We can shrink to 01:00-02:10 UTC and start canary earlier at 01:05. That keeps us clear of the 02:00 disk window. PM ok?
pm-luminary: Prefer earlier. 01:05 start is fine. We'll keep our traffic steering paused until the warmup completes.
sam: Proposed rollback triggers (canary):
- error-rate (5xx or generation-fail) >= 1.5% for 5m
- p95 latency increase > 60% over baseline for 5m
- any node-level OOM
Auto-rollback action: promote fallback v2.3.5 for the canary slice and pause promotion. Notify Luminary and SRE. Manual approval required to resume.
qa: Also add a quick eval check against our saved prompts (eval set lumi-v1). If generation-quality regressions > 2% we stop.
infra: Confirmed: shifting to 01:00-02:10 avoids firmware window. KMS rotations: none in relevant regions during window.
olivia: Runbook snippets:
`/deploy start --customer=lumi-corp --env=dedicated --version=v2.4.0-rc2 --canary=8% --window=2026-05-05T01:05Z/2026-05-05T02:10Z --fallback=v2.3.5 --pin`
Manual promote command:
`/deploy promote --job=jb-82190 --to=100% --approver=sam`
Manual rollback:
`/deploy rollback --customer=lumi-corp --to=v2.3.5 --reason=canary-fail --force`
deploybot: Scheduling job jb-82190 (canary start 2026-05-05T01:05Z). Will post: canary:start, metrics (2m cadence), canary:status, canary:finish. Alerts will link to: https://grafana.internal/redwood/lumi-canary-jb-82190
sam: I'll be standby for the promote approval. QA, please ping when the eval run completes (we want 30m clear).
qa: Will start eval immediately at canary start and post results to this thread.
pm-luminary: Please CC our SRE alias on rollback notifications: sre+lumi@luminary.com.
olivia: Added the alias to the deploybot notify list. Also setting circuit-breaker: if canary rollback occurs, deployment stops and requires manual resume.
sam: Approver for promote will be me. I require 30m stability + eval ok + no infra alerts.
deploybot: Approval queue waiting. To lock and approve run `/deploy approve 4171200456`
sam: /deploy approve 4171200456
deploybot: Approval recorded: sam. Canary job jb-82190 confirmed. Good luck team :rocket:
